name: omni-catcher
description: Capture anything, classify with an agent, confirm, and save as local Markdown.

scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:server && pnpm build:web
scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @omni-catcher/server dev" "pnpm --filter @omni-catcher/web dev"
